rationale: Both responses use the standard construction. Q(x) = (x^2-1)p(x) - x has roots 2 through 7 and degree at most 7, so it factors as the sextic times a linear factor, which is pinned down by evaluating at x = ±1. Both get the same correct coefficients and p(8) = 3/56. Response B shows how the linear system is solved: it rewrites 1/720 as 28/20160 and adds the equations to get B, then A. Response A simply announces a and b. B also simplifies 259/56 to 37/8, which makes the final arithmetic easier to follow. Both are sound, but B leaves fewer steps to the reader.
